issues.description: The type of the Course.ratings property (and the corresponding initializer parameter) is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement and the template declare ratings as [Int], but the solution declares ratings as [Double]. This mismatch will confuse students about the intended type and leads to type errors in the solution (e.g., appending Int values to a [Double] array and summing Double values into an Int accumulator).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the types across artifacts. Preferably change the solution to use ratings: [Int] and an initializer parameter ratings: [Int], ensure addRating(stars:) appends Int values, and update getAverageRating() to sum Int ratings and return Double(Double(sum) / Double(count)). Alternatively, if you intend to use Double ratings, update the problem statement and template to specify [Double] consistently.
